mapping.sheet: Default collar sheet = measured 1.6 mm; range1.6–2 mm. Backboard redesigned2–2.6 mm for >=1.4mm engraving backing.
mapping.socket: Measured source RECEIVING slot width4.5mm is adopted as nominal width scale. Our4.5mm rectangular tongues are a proposed reconstruction, not a claim of measured source male width. Our receiving sockets=(4.5+TOTAL allowance)x(sheet+TOTAL allowance). Default4.65x1.75mm; intentionally not identical source fit.
mapping.runners: Reference low layers .21/.22mm inspired real bed-level breakaway carriers. Proposed .4–.6mm thick,.8–1.4mm wide tabs improve access,12 total.
mapping.assembly: Replace spacecraft assembly with two parallel pierced collars inserted horizontally into four backboard sockets. Four fixed adhesive seats, no moving joint or snap-fit claim.
mapping.acoustics: External stopped straws; crude quarter-wave cutting schedule with end correction, not printed tubes or tested tuning.
